characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 误 began as a mistake in speech, later broadening to 'error' in general.
吴 (wú) gives a sound close to wù, with the tone shifted.

etymology.hint: Someone 亻 who can build 建 things; 建 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 健 describes a person's physical condition.
建 depicts building or constructing — a person strong enough to build things gave 健 its meaning 'strong, healthy.'

makemeahanzi.definition: close by, near, next to, towards, against; to lean on; to wait

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — being close by is described using a hand-related radical.
矣 (yǐ) gives a sound distantly related to āi, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A solider 兵 quartered under one's roof 宀

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof) — 宾 describes someone welcomed under one's roof.
兵 (soldier) — a soldier 兵 quartered under one's roof 宀 gave 宾 its meaning 'guest, visitor.'
车 (cart/vehicle) — 较 originally related to comparing the crossbars of chariots
交 (jiāo) gives a sound close to 较's reading jiào
A simple curling shape representing a cloud drifting in the sky.

makemeahanzi.definition: to hold in the mouth; to contain; to cherish

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 含 originally meant to hold something in the mouth.
今 (jīn) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading hán has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: to block, to hinder, to obstruct

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — blocking someone's path is often done by hand.
兰 (lán) gives the sound — an exact match for 拦.
纟 (thread) — rope is made by twisting thread or fiber together.
黾 (mǐn) gives a sound distantly related to shéng, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A bird 隹 getting its tail singed 灬

characterDeckComponents.note: 隹 (a bird) sits above, the thing being affected by fire.
灬 (flames) beneath shows fire scorching it, giving 焦 its meaning 'burnt, scorched' and later 'anxious.'

makemeahanzi.definition: summer; the Xia or Hsia dynasty

etymology.hint: Speech 讠 that explains the logic 仑; 仑 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 论 relates to discussing or explaining something with words.
仑 (logical order, arrangement) — combined with speech, 论 came to mean 'to discuss' or 'a theory,' explaining ideas in an orderly way.

makemeahanzi.definition: to compensate, to pay damages, to suffer a loss

characterDeckComponents.note: Money/shell — ancient currency, linking to financial loss.
Gives the sound pǒu, related to péi but drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: adornment, make-up; to dress up, to use make-up

characterDeckComponents.note: 女 (woman) — 妆 describes putting on makeup, an action tied to appearance.
丬 gives a sound related to zhuāng, though the connection has drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to annoy, to disturb, to stir up

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 搅 describes stirring something with the hands.
觉 (jiào) gives a sound close to jiǎo, the same syllable with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: to cure, to heal, to treat; doctor; medicine

characterDeckComponents.note: 矢 (arrow) — 医 originally related to treating arrow wounds, the root of its meaning 'to cure, doctor'
匸 gives a loose sound connection to 医's reading yī

etymology.hint: Words 言 that must not be broken 折; 折 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 折 (to break) here suggests something that must never be broken.
言 (speech) sits below — words that must not be broken, giving 誓 its meaning 'oath, vow.'

makemeahanzi.definition: cushion, mat, pad; to advance money, to pay for another

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — an older semantic link to a raised base or foundation.
执 (zhí) gives a sound distantly related to diàn, having drifted apart over time.
氵 (water) — 湾 names a curved body of water, a bay.
弯 (wān) gives the sound — an exact match with 湾.
纟 (silk/thread) — 细 relates to something as fine and thin as silk thread
田 (tián) gives a loose sound connection to 细's reading xì
Heart — feeling gloomy is an emotional state.
Gives the sound mén, related to mèn but drifted apart over time.
饣 (food) — 饶 was originally tied to abundance of food, later broadening to mean plentiful in general.
尧 (yáo) gives a sound close to ráo, sharing the rhyme -áo.

makemeahanzi.definition: fearful, apprehensive; to fear, to dread

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 (heart) — 恐 describes fear felt in the heart.
巩 (gǒng) gives a sound close to kǒng, sharing the same rhyme.

etymology.hint: Clear 白 jade 王; 白 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (jade) — 珀 relates to a precious, gem-like material.
白 (white, clear) — a clear, translucent material, giving 珀 its meaning 'amber.'
木 (tree) — 梅 names the plum tree.
每 (měi) gives a sound close to méi, sharing the same syllable body and differing only in tone.

meanings: abbr. for 俄羅斯|俄罗斯[E2 luo2 si1]

characterDeckComponents.note: 我 (wǒ) reflects the character's phonetic root, though the sound has diverged over time from the modern reading é.

meanings: for a particular person, occasion, purpose

makemeahanzi.definition: to water, to irrigate; to pour; to flood

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — irrigation and pouring both involve water.
雚 (an ancestor of characters like 观 and 权) gives a sound close to guàn.

makemeahanzi.definition: to add, to append, to increase, to replenish

characterDeckComponents.note: Water — an early sense linked to adding liquid, later broadened.
Gives the sound tiǎn, related to tiān but drifted apart over time.
口 (mouth) — a spoken particle is voiced through the mouth.
里 (lǐ) gives the sound — a close match for lī, differing only in tone.
钅 (metal) — pots and pans are made of metal.
呙 (guō) gives the sound — an exact match for 锅.
艹 (grass/plant) — 艺 originally related to planting and cultivating skillfully
乙 (yǐ) gives a sound distantly related to 艺's reading yì, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: bang! the sound of crashing rock

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (stone) — 砰 relates to an impact, as of something crashing.
平 (píng) gives a sound related to 砰's reading pēng, sharing the initial though the final has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: pit, hole; to trap, to bury; to harry

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 坑 names a hole dug in the ground.
亢 (kàng) is close in initial to kēng (both start with k-), though the rhyme has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to petition, to submit; to appear, to show

etymology.hint: To speak 口 before a king 王

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) on top represents speaking or presenting something.
王 (a king) below shows who the words are presented to, giving 呈 its meaning 'to submit, to present.'

makemeahanzi.definition: glue, gum, resin, rubber; sticky; to glue

etymology.hint: Tendons that connect 交 muscles ⺼; 交 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh) marks the body — muscles held together.
交 (to cross, to connect) sits beside it — tendons connecting muscles, giving 胶 its meaning 'glue.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to hook, to join, to connect; to entice

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — urging is something one person does to another.
崔 (cuī) gives the sound — an exact match for 催.
疒 (sickness) — 癖 originally described an internal ailment, later broadening to any deep-seated habit or craving.
辟 (pì) gives a sound close to 癖's reading pǐ, differing only in tone.

meanings: Yin (the negative principle of Yin and Yang)

makemeahanzi.definition: the female principle; dark, shaded; hidden, implicit, secret

etymology.hint: The place 阝 of the moon 月; compare 阳

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound, a place) — 阴 relates to the shaded side of a hill.
月 (moon) — the moon, associated with night and shade, gave 阴 its meaning 'shady, overcast'; compare 阳, which uses 日 (sun) for the opposite, sunny meaning.

makemeahanzi.definition: chip, tally, token; to plan; to raise money

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) reflects an early material used for counting tallies, the origin of 筹's meaning.
寿 (shòu) gives a sound distantly related to chóu, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: group, organization, society; a god of the soil

etymology.hint: An earth 土 spirit 礻; 礻 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 礻 (an altar, related to ritual) — 社 relates to worship and community gatherings.
土 (earth) — ancient communities worshipped a local earth spirit together, giving 社 its meaning 'society' or 'community.'
虫 (insect) — honey is made by bees, which are insects.
宓 (mì) gives the sound — an exact match for 蜜.

makemeahanzi.definition: thin, slight; meager, weak; poor, stingy

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — 薄 originally described sparse, thin grass, extending to 'thin' in general.
溥 (pǔ) is only distantly related in sound to báo — the rhyme has drifted apart over time.
钅 (metal) — bells are made of metal.
令 (lìng) gives the sound — a close match for líng, differing only in tone.

etymology.hint: Grain 禾 paid as tribute 兑; 兑 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — grain handed over as payment
兑 (to exchange) — the act of exchanging goods for an official tribute

makemeahanzi.definition: process, rules; journey, trip; agenda, schedule

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — 程 originally named a unit for measuring grain, extended to 'process, journey, degree.'
呈 (chéng) gives the sound — 程 is also pronounced chéng, an exact match.

meanings: to hold between the thumb and fingers
to hold (lit. in one's hand and fig.)

makemeahanzi.definition: to knead, to mold, to pinch

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 捏 is an action done with the fingers.
圼 (niè) gives a sound close to niē; 圼 is a rare character used mainly as a phonetic here.

meanings: abbr. for 衛生|卫生, hygiene
abbr. for 衛生間|卫生间, toilet

makemeahanzi.definition: to guard, to protect, to defend
